visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with vibrant green-dyed hair and visible makeup is seen in a medium close-up, holding two pink round blush compacts with gold logos over her eyes like glasses. She is wearing a dark grey t-shirt with a cut-out design on the chest. The background is a soft-focus indoor setting with warm lighting. (2) The camera zooms in to her hand as she swatches two shades of blush on her skin; the labels 'YSL #93' and 'YSL #44' appear as text overlays. She then uses a fluffy makeup brush to apply the blush to her left cheek, smiling and looking into the camera. (3) She presents alternative blush products, holding up a square clear plastic palette and a rectangular orange compact. She demonstrates the application of these 'dupes' on her other cheek, comparing the texture and sheen under bright studio lighting. (4) The video concludes with a close-up of her face as she poses, touching her cheek to highlight the radiant, shimmery finish of the makeup, with small animated heart and sparkle graphics appearing around her.
